review_notes:
I read the whole file and searched Mathlib for competing versions of its main definitions. I found no justified finding.

- `valueAtInfty` is a new name for `limUnder atImInfty f`. It is used in LFunction.lean and CuspFormSubmodule.lean, and I found no other definition of the value at the cusp. This is a useful named specialisation.
- `UpperHalfPlane.cuspFunction` wraps `Function.Periodic.cuspFunction` from Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/Periodic.lean, composed with `ofComplex`. It reuses the existing definition and adds no competing one.
- `qExpansion` is a `PowerSeries` of Taylor coefficients. I found no existing Mathlib definition of Taylor coefficients as a `PowerSeries`, since `hasSum_taylorSeries_on_ball` states the formula explicitly.
- `qExpansionFormalMultilinearSeries` is a thin wrapper around `FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars`. A TODO in the file proposes replacing it with a general `PowerSeries` to `FormalMultilinearSeries` API. I grepped Mathlib/Analysis and found no such API, so there is nothing existing to switch to. The definition is used only in this file (13 occurrences). Removing it would only move the conversion lemmas elsewhere, so I did not report it.
- `qExpansionAddHom`, `qExpansionRingHom` and `qExpansionAlgHom` build on `DirectSum.toSemiring` and `DirectSum.toAlgebra`. They are named bundlings of the file's own `qExpansion`, so they are not duplicates.

The remaining declarations are lemmas about these definitions, which this rubric excludes.
